title: fix(fleet): stop lanes parking issues on the maintainer assignee

labels.name: audit:no-issue
labels.description: No spawning issue; judged on stated intent

body:
Before: `repo-sweeper.yml` assigned `dezren39` to every open issue and PR every 15 minutes (1,094 open issues are assigned to him, 3 are not). The queue lane runbook says "never touch a held or Drew-owned PR", and lanes read the blanket assignment, and PRs authored under his account, as Drew ownership. They parked the issue until an "explicit ownership release/handoff" that nobody gives, then picked it up again 30 minutes later and posted the same pick-up and park notes. #7616 has 54 agent notes since Nov 17 and no code.

After: neither the assignee nor PR authorship means anything to a lane. Only a hold label holds work: `held`, `user/owned` or `do-not-auto-edit`, while `do-not-merge` blocks merging only. That matches the claimant's existing `HARD_STOP` set. Lanes get a deterministic check for it and a park-note dedupe, and the blanket assignment stops.

How:
- Delete `.github/workflows/repo-sweeper.yml`. Its only step was the blanket assign.
- `AGENTS.md`: add a "Who holds an issue" section. Lanes run in `~/git/code`, so OpenCode loads it every session. The section says:
  - Assignees, `work/assigned` and `dezren39`-authored PRs never hold work.
  - A lane posts at most one park note per task per day.
  - A task too big for one run lands a slice instead of parking with no code.
- `pm-stack/lane-guard/lane_guard.py` adds two checks:
  - `hold`: exit 0 means workable, 3 means held.
  - `note`: exit 3 means a duplicate park or pick-up note, posted within 24h with no human comment since. It prints a canonical note header.

  It parses the free-form note shapes that lanes post today.
- 27 offline tests in `test_lane_guard.py`, wired into `pm-stack-tests.yml` and `.github/test-suite-registry.json`. One test pins the hold labels to `launch_one.HARD_STOP`.

Impact, from the latest park note on 53 parked issues that mention ownership:
- **9 parked only on ownership:** 6 on the assignee, 3 on a `dezren39`-authored PR (#2686, #8467, #8469, #9075, #9132, #9349, #10363, #12029, #12042). This change frees them.
- **14 cite ownership plus "needs a dedicated window" or effort/l.** The new slice rule covers them.
- **5 cite ownership plus a real blocker.** On #10040 and #10041 that blocker is stale: #10040's PR #11439 merged.
- **The 28 issues that cite ownership logged about 263 park notes on Nov 19.**
- **Live check:** `hold` returns workable for #7616 and #9991. Replaying #7616's 56 agent notes through `note` keeps 17 and drops 39 repeats.

Not in this PR:
- Existing assignments stay. Unassigning about 1,094 issues is a separate call.
- The OpenChamber lane prompts on the laptop are unchanged. They defer to AGENTS.md.
- 10 parked issues wait on "Summit" design ownership. That is the same release pattern with a different owner, and it is left alone here.
